reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: I want a mattress we'll sleep great on, at a fair price, with a hassle-free trial and return if it isn't right.

scenarios.label: Couple main replacement
scenarios.description: A couple replacing a sagging queen/king and seeking an all-rounder with motion isolation and a safe trial.

scenarios.label: Upsizing to king
scenarios.description: Moving to a larger bedroom or growing family and upgrading to a king/Cal king for space and edge support.

scenarios.label: First apartment budget
scenarios.description: Setting up a first place on a tight budget and needing fast delivery and good-enough comfort under a price cap.

scenarios.label: Organic materials buyer
scenarios.description: Prioritizing certified non-toxic, natural materials and willing to pay more for verified eco credentials.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Couple main replacement|generic] we keep rolling into a saggy dip in the middle and taking turns waking each other up. i'm hot all night, he's stiff by morning. this is our main sleep spot. how do we make it not miserable?

[problem_recognition|Upsizing to king|generic] both of us are tall, plus the dog claims the middle, so we are constantly elbowing each other. want more room and less bumping when one of us moves. where do we even start?

[problem_recognition|First apartment budget|generic] moving into my first place. whatever i sleep on now kills my back and i have about 500 to spend. how do i get something comfy that is not trash in six months?

[problem_recognition|Organic materials buyer|generic] new stuff that smells like chemicals gives me headaches. i want to sleep on natural materials, no sketchy coatings, and i care where it is sourced. sensitive skin. how do i avoid the off-gassing plastics route?

[category_education|-|generic] basic question. what is a mattress supposed to do, exactly? support, pressure relief, keeping two people from smashing into the middle, staying cool, sizing. how do these pieces fit together?

[discovery|Couple main replacement|generic] best mattress for a couple that keeps rolling to the middle. we need strong motion isolation, sleeps cool, and a medium to medium-firm feel for side plus back sleepers.
[discovery|Upsizing to king|generic] looking for the best king mattress for two tall people and a dog. solid edge support, not a heat trap, around 2k. what should be on my radar?
[discovery|First apartment budget|generic] best affordable mattress for a first apartment. budget 400 to 700, side sleeper, small room, would like it to last a few years.

[discovery|Organic materials buyer|generic] best non toxic, natural-material mattress with real certifications. latex or wool and cotton is fine, low VOC, not greenwashed. medium feel for combo sleeper.
[shortlist|Couple main replacement|generic] can you narrow it to 3 or 4 good options for a couple replacing the main sleep setup? we fight a mid-line dip, need great motion control, and i sleep hot.
[shortlist|Upsizing to king|generic] please give me a short list of 3 king options with strong edges and cooling, good for two tall people and a dog, target budget about 2k.
[shortlist|First apartment budget|generic] i have 500 to 700, first apartment, side sleeper, not heavy. can you give me three solid options that will not fall apart in a year or two?

[shortlist|Organic materials buyer|generic] i want a small set to compare. organic and natural materials only, real third-party certifications, medium feel, low VOC, no polyurethane foam. can you give me 3 picks?
[criteria|Couple main replacement|generic] we're replacing our main bed as a couple. what should we actually look for so we both sleep well? i'm a side sleeper, he moves a lot.
[criteria|Upsizing to king|generic] Upsizing to a king for a bigger room. what matters most when picking a king mattress besides just price? anything about split vs one piece, edge support, bases?
[criteria|First apartment budget|generic] first apartment, tight budget. what specs matter so I don't end up with a saggy rock? side sleeper, 140 lb, NYC walk-up.

[criteria|Organic materials buyer|generic] I want a mattress that feels clean and aligns with my values. what should I look for in truly organic or natural builds and certifications, and what red flags scream greenwash?

[use_case|Couple main replacement|generic] Need a new main mattress for two: I'm a side sleeper who runs hot, partner is back sleeper and wakes if I move. We need good motion control and cooling without feeling stuck. What types fit this?

[use_case|Upsizing to king|generic] Moving next month and going king. Narrow staircase, dog sleeps with us, prefer medium-firm. How should I pick between one-piece king, split king, thickness, and base so delivery and nightly use aren't a pain?

[use_case|First apartment budget|generic] Got about 600 for a queen, first place. 3rd-floor walk-up, mostly side sleeping, occasional back pain. Need something I can unbox myself that won't crater in a year. Point me to the right kind of build?

[use_case|Organic materials buyer|generic] Looking for a bed that feels natural: latex, wool, cotton, low smell. I like a buoyant, not memory-foam sink. How do I spec this out and avoid hidden synthetics in layers or glue?

[social_validation|-|generic] Where do shoppers actually rave or complain about mattresses? any places to see real-world ratings over time, not just store sites, like Reddit threads, owner surveys, return rates?

[comparison|Couple main replacement|Casper] For a couple replacing our main bed, how does Purple stack up against Casper on motion transfer, edge support, cooling, and long-term durability? which one handles a side-plus-back combo better?

[comparison|Upsizing to king|Tempur-Pedic] Upsizing to a king. Is Purple a legit alternative to Tempur-Pedic if I want that pressure relief feel without the super deep slow sink? budget is under 2500, open to split king if it helps.

[comparison|First apartment budget|Saatva] First apartment budget but I want something that will last. Between Purple and Saatva entry models, which is the smarter buy for a queen under 1200, and what do I give up either way?

[comparison|Organic materials buyer|Nectar] Values-first buyer here. Between Purple and Nectar, which lines up better on low VOC, certifications, and minimal off-gassing, and what does each actually feel like day 1 vs after a month?

[objections|Couple main replacement|generic] We're replacing our main bed. For a couple, is Purple actually supportive long term? I'm worried the grid will sag in the middle, motion transfer will bug us, and the edges feel soft. We both sleep warm.

[objections|Upsizing to king|generic] Upsizing to a king. Does Purple keep even support edge to edge at that size, or does the middle get squishy and bouncy? I need solid motion isolation and sturdy edges.

[objections|First apartment budget|generic] First apartment budget here. If I go with the basic Purple to save money, am I giving up real support? I don't want back pain or that stuck-in-the-grid feel.

[objections|Organic materials buyer|generic] I usually buy natural latex and wool beds and care a lot about feel and trust. Purple's synthetic grid has me nervous. Is the performance there day to day, good pressure relief without a plasticky vibe or heat, or will it feel off to me?

[pricing|Couple main replacement|generic] For a couple, is there real value stepping up within Purple's lineup? Like from the entry model to one of their pricier hybrids, do you actually get better motion isolation and support, or is the base one fine? Any delivery or return fees I should expect?

[pricing|Upsizing to king|generic] Going from queen to king, what's the typical price jump for decent online mattresses? Do most brands charge extra for shipping, old mattress haul-away, or returns on a king?

[pricing|First apartment budget|generic] Tight budget for my first place. Can I get a solid queen under about 700 all in with promos, or is that asking for sag and bad sleep? Where do people actually save without buying junk?

[pricing|Organic materials buyer|generic] I care about natural materials but I'm eyeing Purple too. If I spend more, is Purple's higher-end build actually better performance for the money, or would a latex-forward mattress at the same price make more sense? And once you add a base and protector, how does Purple pricing really shake out?

[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've had a Purple for a few years and I'm waking up stiff and seeing a dip. Do I try fixes like rotating and checking the base, or is it time to change models? If I stay with Purple, which version would feel firmer and hold up better?
[alternatives|-|defensive] If I don't go with Purple, what mattresses feel similar? Side sleeper, want medium-firm and good cooling, under 1500.
[alternatives|-|Casper] Casper felt a bit soft to me. What other mattresses have a similar foam feel but slightly firmer?
[alternatives|-|Tempur-Pedic] I like the slow sink and pressure relief of Tempur-Pedic but can't swing that price. What are solid alternatives with a similar feel?
[alternatives|-|Saatva] Considering Saatva for that hotel-style innerspring feel. What other options give strong edge support and a buoyant feel?
[alternatives|-|Nectar] Nectar keeps popping up. If I want a comparable memory foam bed that sleeps cooler, what else should I look at?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] My Purple just arrived and it looks a little lopsided after unboxing, plus the cover has stubborn wrinkles. Do I just wait it out or is there a way to fix it? When should I contact support?
[expansion|-|generic] We love our Purple in the primary. Thinking of getting one for the guest room and maybe our kid. Which Purple model makes sense for lighter sleepers and occasional use?
[ecosystem|-|generic] What pairs well with a Purple mattress? Looking for sheets that won't bunch on the grid, a breathable protector, and an adjustable base that fits right.
[advocacy|-|generic] Friend says Purple is a gimmick. How do I explain the grid's pressure relief and cooling in normal-people terms, especially for side sleepers?
